336.name: ci3_health_questionnaire
336.title: Health Questionnaire (EuroQoL)
336.description:
Below you will find health questionnaire related to your quality
of life. We will ask you to answer how you are doing in FIVE different areas listed below

1.1.field_description:
Below you will find health questionnaire related to your quality
of life. We will ask you to answer how you are doing in FIVE different areas listed below

1.2.field_constraint_data: I have no problems in walking about|I have slight problems in walking about|I have moderate problems in walking about|I have severe problems in walking about|I am unable to walk about

1.3.field_constraint_data: I have no problems washing or dressing myself|I have slight problems washing or dressing myself|I have moderate problems washing or dressing myself|I have severe problems washing or dressing myself|I am unable to wash or dress myself

1.4.field_title: USUAL ACTIVITIES (e.g. work, study, housework, family or leisure activities)
1.4.field_constraint_data: I have no problems doing my usual activities|I have slight problems doing my usual activities|I have moderate problems doing my usual activities|I have severe problems doing  my usual activities|I am unable to do my usual activities

1.5.field_constraint_data: I have no pain or discomfort|I have slight pain or discomfort|I have moderate pain or discomfort|I have severe pain or discomfort|I have extreme pain or discomfort

1.6.field_constraint_data: I am not anxious or depressed|I am slightly anxious or depressed|I am moderately anxious or depressed|I am severely anxious or depressed|I am extremely anxious or depressed

1.7.field_description:
• We would like to know how good or bad your health is TODAY.
  • This scale is numbered from 0 to 100
  • 100 means the best health you can imagine

    0 means the worst health you can imagine

  • Please use slider to indicate how your health is today
